name: 10万+爆款选题制造机
examples_zh: 帮我想个公众号选题，最近这个热点怎么蹭
给这篇文章起 5 个爆款标题
这段素材适合做成短视频还是漫画？帮我出个方案
examples_en: Help me come up with a WeChat article topic around this trending news
Write 5 viral headlines for this article
Is this material better as a short video or a comic? Give me a plan
iconLocalPath: 请替换为你本地的图标存放目录
description_zh: 公众号编辑、短视频博主、漫画作者、H5 策划必备，热点爆款策划的好帮手。把热点、产品或个人经历炼成爆款选题、标题与全形态创作方案（文章/短视频/漫画/H5），用爆款四基因和 12 条策划心法先筛后做，附 8 维打分、传播锚点与风险自检。
description_en: An essential viral-content planning assistant for WeChat editors, short-video creators, comic authors and H5 planners. It forges hot topics, products or personal stories into viral topics, titles and full-format content plans (article / short video / comic / H5), screening ideas through four viral genes and 12 planning principles, with 8-dimension scoring, shareable anchors and risk self-checks.
